title: Scripted two-way Linear sync for the intake queue
body:
Build the scripted two-way sync between `intake/queue/` and the Linear project
**AdventureForge** (workspace linear.app/michael-crosato, team `MIC`), replacing
the manual orchestrator-MCP procedure documented in `docs/linear_workflow.md`.

What already exists (2026-08-30): the Linear project, labels (`intake-mirror`,
`source:*`, `lane:*`), and 24 mirrored issues MIC-5..MIC-28 whose titles carry
the repo submission id as a `[16-hex]` prefix — that prefix is the join key.
Priority map: P0/P1/P2/P3 ↔ Urgent/High/Medium/Low.

Build it on the `scripts/sync-intake-github.ts` pattern: marker-idempotent,
LINEAR_API_KEY from local env only (never committed), `--dry-run` mode first.
Repo → Linear: open submissions upsert issues; repo closes move issues to Done.
Linear → repo: assignee/priority changes surface as claim suggestions or
priority edits — but the repo file always wins disagreements (see
docs/linear_workflow.md), and the script must never close a repo item from
Linear state alone.

Acceptance: dry-run against the live queue reports zero spurious diffs after an
immediately-preceding manual sync; a round-trip (file → issue → close → Done)
is idempotent when run twice.
